specs.title: cp-000: Navigating to posternew loads the creation wizard at Step 0
cp-001: Navigating to posterposterId with a valid ID loads the poster editor
cp-002: Navigating to posterposterId with an invalid ID shows an appropriate error
cp-003: Back button in editor navigates to poster ArrowLeft icon
cp-004: Step 0 displays the heading Select Source Material
cp-005: All 7 source types are rendered with correct icons
cp-006: Papers source BookOpen icon is selectable and functional
cp-007: Document source FileText icon is selectable and functional
cp-008: Text source TextT icon is selectable and functional
cp-009: References source BookBookmark icon is selectable and functional
cp-010: URL source Globe icon is selectable and functional
cp-011: Import Deck source Presentation icon is selectable and functional
cp-012: Deep Research source Sparkle icon is selectable and functional
cp-013: Validation cannot proceed without a selection that has data
cp-014: Validation text input requires more than 50 characters
cp-015: Text input with exactly 50 characters is rejected
cp-016: Text input with 51 characters is accepted
cp-017: Back button navigates to poster
cp-018: Selecting a source type highlights it visually
cp-019: Step 1 displays the heading Poster Size Template
cp-020: All 6 poster sizes are displayed in a grid

cp-022: Selecting each poster size updates the state correctly
cp-023: All 4 grid layouts are displayed in a grid with descriptions
cp-024: Default grid layout is three_column
cp-025: Selecting each grid layout updates the state correctly
cp-026: 4 templates are shown with an optional toggle
cp-027: Templates can be toggled onoff optional selection
cp-028: Clicking a size visually highlights the selected option
cp-029: Clicking a layout visually highlights the selected option
cp-030: Step 2 displays the heading Configure Poster
cp-031: Title input field is present with placeholder eg Impact of Novel Therapy on Pati
cp-032: Title input has autofocus enabled
cp-033: Title input is required cannot proceed without it
cp-034: Theme picker displays as a 7-column grid
